params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or a field.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

params.name: arrEvents
params.description: Array of predefined (Form Events theme) or custom Longint event codes to modify; the On Load event cannot be included.

params.name: mode
params.description: Activation mode for the events listed in arrEvents

sentinelValues.meaning: Enable events disable others -- events in arrEvents are enabled, all other events are disabled
Enable events others unchanged -- events in arrEvents are enabled, other events keep their current status
Disable events others unchanged -- events in arrEvents are disabled, other events keep their current status

overloads.semanticRole: Modifies, for the current process, the enabled/disabled configuration of the form events of the form or object(s) designated by object and *.

constraints: To configure events for the form itself (rather than an object), pass * together with an empty string "" in object.
To modify a subform's events for a related table, only the object-name syntax (with *) works.
Custom (non-predefined) event codes should use negative values.
Enabling events unsupported by the object's type is harmless; they are simply ignored.
If an object is duplicated after this command is called, the resulting event configuration is duplicated with it.
